build_supervised_kilt_dataset: build a supervised KILT dataset from input JSONL with a knowledge base and target extraction mode
extract_spans_from_text: extract text spans from a passage using fuzzy matching against a source query with configurable temperature
iterate_kilt_provenance: iterate over KILT samples to yield source-target pairs from provenance knowledge base entries
preprocess_knowledge_base: preprocess a tab-separated knowledge base file into an indexed dictionary of title-text pairs
run_make_supervised_dataset_cli: run the make_supervised_kilt_dataset CLI with input, output, kb, and target arguments
